premium.faq.q.freeChange.message: Will the free version be cut back?

premium.faq.a.freeChange.message: No. The free version stays complete and will keep evolving at the same pace. Premium is for servers that need more: extended limits, advanced customization and early access.

premium.faq.q.lifetime.message: What does “price locked for life” mean?

premium.faq.a.lifetime.message: The Founder offer locks your price permanently. As long as your subscription stays active, your price never changes, even once new plans are introduced and the Founder offer is removed from the store.

premium.faq.a.activate.message: Type /settings on your Discord server and click “Premium”, or go straight to the RaidProtect store in Discord. Activation takes a few seconds.

premium.faq.a.cancel.message: Yes. The subscription is managed from Discord and can be cancelled whenever you want, with no commitment.

premium.faq.q.businessDiff.message: What's the difference between Founder and Business?

premium.faq.a.businessDiff.message: Founder unlocks bot customization and extended limits on every module. Business adds a dedicated, isolated instance plus human support (audit, custom integration, expert follow-up), on request.

mockup.tagrole.desc1.message: Configure the **Server Tag Role** to **automatically assign a role** to members who add **your server's tag to their profile**.

mockup.tagrole.desc2.message: If the member removes the tag, the role is automatically removed.

mockup.transparency.intro.message: **37** moderation actions were taken during this period.

mockup.settingsMenus.antispam.desc.message: Set up anti-spam to protect your Discord server from malicious user actions.

mockup.settingsMenus.antispam.high.message: 🔴 **High:** Sanctions all spam, including in ignored channels.

mockup.settingsMenus.antispam.medium.message: 🟡 **Medium:** Sanctions spam, but respects ignored channels.

mockup.settingsMenus.antispam.low.message: 🟢 **Low:** Only targets link, mention and selfbot spam.

mockup.settingsMenus.antispamSanctions.d.message: You can customize the sanctions applied depending on the type of spam detected. This allows for a response adapted to the severity of the violation.

mockup.settingsMenus.antispamSanctions.m.message: Replaces the trigger's sanction when spam spans several channels, only if it is more severe.

mockup.settingsMenus.antispamSanctions.p.message: Posts a message in the channel to announce the sanction (e.g. 'member has been muted'). Can be disabled with premium.

mockup.settingsMenus.reports.channelDesc.message: Configure the **channel** where **report notifications** will be sent.

mockup.settingsMenus.reports.roleDesc.message: Configure the **role that will be notified** when a **new report** is received. Typically, a moderator role.

mockup.settingsMenus.reports.notifyDesc.message: Choose **what reporters receive in DM** once their report has been handled.

mockup.settingsMenus.reports.trustedDesc.message: Members with this **trusted role** can apply a **preventive 24h timeout** when they report, pending moderator review.

mockup.settingsMenus.reports.badDesc.message: Act on members whose reports keep getting refused. Set the refused-report threshold, the time window, and what happens once the threshold is reached.

mockup.settingsMenus.reports.desc.message: Enable the **Reporting System** to allow members to **easily notify your team** of problematic situations.

mockup.settingsMenus.reports.groupValue.message: Reports about the same member are grouped into a single alert.

mockup.settingsMenus.reports.groupSepara.message: Every report creates its own separate alert.

mockup.settingsMenus.raidmode.thresholdD.message: Sets the maximum number of new members allowed to join the server within 10 seconds before RaidMode is activated.

mockup.settingsMenus.raidmode.durationDe.message: Sets the duration for which RaidMode remains active before automatically deactivating.

mockup.settingsMenus.raidmode.desc.message: Configure automatic anti-raid mode, which determines the maximum number of members that can join your server in 10 seconds. When the threshold is exceeded, flagged members are kicked and invites are disabled for the configured duration.

mockup.settingsMenus.raidmode.kickModeEn.message: Kicks members on join and sends them a DM with an invite to rejoin the server

mockup.settingsMenus.captcha.desc.message: Configure Captcha to prevent selfbots from accessing your Discord server and block raids.

mockup.settingsMenus.dmlock.desc1.message: Configure direct messages closing to prevent phishing or scam attempts.

mockup.settingsMenus.dmlock.desc2.message: RaidProtect will permanently disable direct messages until you disable this protection. We use the "Discord Security Actions" feature (limited to 24h by Discord, extended to always by RaidProtect).

mockup.settingsMenus.dmlock.warning.message: Only bots, members who have already exchanged or are friends and staff will be able to receive DMs with this mode.

mockup.settingsMenus.language.desc.message: The configured language only affects public messages sent by RaidProtect in your server (logs, captcha messages, reports, etc.). Private or temporary messages remain displayed in the language of the user interacting with the bot.

mockup.settingsMenus.prefix.desc1.message: Select a prefix for message commands. If none is set, message commands will be disabled.

mockup.settingsMenus.prefix.deleteDesc.message: **Delinvoke:** Automatically deletes the message containing the command when using prefix commands.

mockup.settingsMenus.logs.desc.message: By default, moderation logs are sent in the RaidProtect log channel. If you wish, you can select another channel.

mockup.settings.desc1.message: This menu allows you to view, adjust or customize features!

mockup.settings.desc2.message: Each category presents a list of customizable options in the form of buttons or dropdown menus. Use the buttons below to configure the various features and settings.

mockup.tagrole.desc3.message: Members will receive the role the next time they update their profile (Username, Avatar, Banner, Roles, Tag…). You can ask support for a full sync of the role if you have many members who currently have or previously had the tag.
